mentions.name: HelloZenno
mentions.description: A language learning app for intermediate learners to practice reading and listening. As the user reads, AI surfaces words they might not know and highlights etymologies and mnemonics, and words are shown in their natural habitat, e.g. by listening to example sentences. The app is a fully generative dictionary and search, where dictionary entries, metadata, and example sentences don't exist until the first person searches for them. Users can upload any kind of content (image, audio, text), which is automatically transcribed, translated, and annotated.
mentions.problem: Intermediate learners who want to practice reading and listening lack in-context help with words they might not know; the author also wanted to experiment with what such an app would look like if AI were trusted to be cheap, fast, and correct.
mentions.audience: Intermediate learners who want to practice reading and listening in a language; the author's own goals include reading a kid's version of The Odyssey in Greek and understanding their partner's mum.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Language learning app for intermediate learners who want to practice reading and listening:

- Highlights etymologies & mnemonics

- Shows you words in their natural habitat, e.g. listen to example sentences
